login_wechat_bot_qr: login to WeChat bot by scanning QR code generated from the ilinkai API
send_text_message_wechat: send a text message to a WeChat user via the WxBotClient send_text method
send_media_file_wechat: send an image, file, or video to a WeChat user via WxBotClient send_image, send_file, or send_video
poll_wechat_updates: poll for incoming WeChat messages using WxBotClient get_updates method
run_wechat_bot_loop: run the WxBotClient message listening loop with an on_message callback handler
